paragraphs.text: He rejoices that God had appointed a place where the ark would still remain.
paragraphs.label: a
paragraphs.anchor: was glad when they said unto

paragraphs.text: Which were wont to wander to and fro, as the ark moved.
paragraphs.label: b
paragraphs.anchor: feet shall stand within thy gates

paragraphs.text: By the artificial joining and beauty of the houses, he means the peace and love that was between the citizens.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: All the tribes according to God's covenant will come and pray there.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: In whose house God placed the throne of justice, and made it a figure of Christ's kingdom.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: The favour of God prosper you both within and without.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: Not only for my own sake but for all the faithful.
